name: EU Cyber Resilience Act — Regulation (EU) 2024/2847 on horizontal cybersecurity requirements for products with digital elements
description: The EU Cyber Resilience Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/2847) sets horizontal essential cybersecurity requirements (Annex I: Part I product properties points 1 and 2(a)-(m); Part II vulnerability-handling points (1)-(8)) and reporting duties (Art. 14) for manufacturers of products with digital elements; it entered into force 10 Dec 2024, with reporting obligations applying from 11 Sep 2026 and full application from 11 Dec 2027. regime_version: Regulation (EU) 2024/2847, OJ 20 Nov 2024; in force 10 Dec 2024. Reporting obligations (Art. 14) apply 11 Sep 2026; full application 11 Dec 2027.
